entities.name: Shadewalkers
entities.description: Mysterious small rogues of Ravnica who can turn invisible, possibly associated with House Dimir.

entities.name: Evern Capobar
entities.description: Person aided by hired shadewalkers in retrieving cerebral fluid from a dragon.

entities.name: Cult of Rakdos
entities.description: Faction to which shadewalkers sold some cerebral fluid.

events.summary: Hired shadewalkers aid Evern Capobar in retrieving cerebral fluid from a dragon for Momir Vig, and sell some to the Cult of Rakdos.
events.quote: Some hired shadewalkers aided Evern Capobar in the retrieval of the cerebral fluid from a dragon for Momir Vig
